title: New Jersey Motorsports Park

services.name: Go Karting
services.desc: Connected to Lightning is NJMP’s 1.1 mile world class karting facility. The karting facility features eight dramatic configurations many of which can be run simultaneously. There are two challenging tracks at Tempest Raceway - Avenger and Liberator. Tempest Raceway is considered one of the top outdoor karting complexes in the U.S. Reservations are strongly recommended and take precedent over those without. Those without reservations will experience longer wait times. We are thrilled to announce that there are now two age groups for a Rental Kart Leagues. blurb: Sitting on more than 500 acres in Millville, N.J., New Jersey Motorsports Park is the premier motorsports entertainment complex in the Northeast. NJMP is conveniently located near Philadelphia and New York City, offering diverse and dynamic attractions both on and off-track.
